All — fast pass on numbers and the operating plan. TL;DR: proposal banding looks sound and we can meet the requested latency targets with reserved burst lanes at a modest uplift. Details below.

Readouts from the export (high level):
- Revised projection: 135M tokens/month steady; expected monthly range 110M–170M with spikes factored in.
- Demo burst: 48 TPS for 12 minutes (short payloads ~60 tokens). Given continuous batching we expect 30–40% token cost savings on the steady workload vs naive per-token pricing.

Pricing suggestion (for the PDF so Aisha can send to MediLens):
- Pay-as-you-go: $1,450 / 1M tokens (no commit) — for trial and sporadic usage.
- Committed 200M/mo: $995 / 1M tokens (mix of reserved capacity + autoscaling). This meets their $900–1,300 target and lands under $1,100.
- Committed + burst-protected: $1,150 / 1M tokens — includes reserved concurrency lanes and a 99th-tail SLA (under 300ms) for interactive paths during 15-minute bursts.

Operational caveats: burst protection requires a small minimum reservation (we recommend a 50 TPS reserve for their peak windows) and a 3-month initial ramp to validate cache hit-rate assumptions. Overages billed at committed band rate + 20%.

Next steps: 
1) Aisha: send the three-band PDF to Sara + procurement and call out the recommended 200M commit and the 50 TPS burst reserve.
2) Priyom: prepare short note on expected batching lift and KV cache assumptions (1-pager).
3) Karthik: schedule an ops sizing sync if they accept the 200M commit.

Happy to join the procurement call next week if they request legal/pricing.
